changes.from: AREA k r - k hits on every enemy unit within r
changes.to: AREA k - k hits on every enemy unit within 1. AREA has no range step

changes.from: 6 per hit at r1, +4 per extra step of range

evidence: A 24-game trace attributing every AP a champion earned to the ability that earned it: ashwyn's W supplies 98% of her income, quillan's R 98%, wisp's W 94%, sable's W and R 98% between them, pallas's R 98%, grivven's R 96%. In every case the engine is a single AREA. The rate scales with reach - the two AREAs at range 2 earned 8.38 and 7.24 AP a round against a roster mean near 2.6, while those at range 1 earned 2.68 to 5.22.
hypothesis: P-0004 failed because a point table prices design-time power and has no grip on a per-activation rate. Reach does: an AREA banks a chip from every unit it touches, so the blast radius is the throttle. Fixing AREA at reach 1 should roughly halve the two worst engines without touching anything else.
success_metric: In a T2 mirror: ashwyn and quillan fall below 2.0x the roster-mean AP per round, and no champion sits above 2.5x.
revert_if: Median game length leaves 13-15 rounds, or mean AP per team-round falls by more than 20%, or ashwyn's or quillan's win-rate CI falls wholly outside [30, 70].
side_effects: Two champions lose their signature reach. quillan's R was a bare AREA and could not remain an ultimate once reach was fixed - k jumps from 6 to 12 gross, either under the per-ability floor or over the spread cap - so it gained a slow rider and its W line came back from n5 to n4. Four champions with reach-1 AREAs (sable, wisp, pallas, grivven) are untouched by this patch and will probably still sit above 1.5x; if they do, the next lever is on the conversion itself rather than the geometry, and that touches the chip-equals-AP pillar, so it is the lead designer's call.

result.verdict: partial - the mechanism is confirmed, the target is not met

batches.held_constant: rules 1.4.0 hidden-zone rules, ai 1.2.0, T2 mirror, tower HP 16

success_metric.target: ashwyn and quillan below 2.0x, nobody above 2.5x
success_metric.verdict: MISS - 2.25x and 2.08x, and sable now leads at 2.54x

result.reading: Reach was the right lever and the evidence is unambiguous: the two AREAs it touched lost 34% and 23% of their absolute income, which no pricing change had managed. But it only reaches the champions who had reach to lose. The three reach-1 AREA engines went up in absolute terms as well as relative, because the roster mean barely moved (2.58 to 2.51) while they kept farming - they were never earning from reach, they earn from standing next to several units at once. Geometry has now been spent. What is left is the conversion itself, and that is the chip-equals-AP pillar, so it is the lead designer's call.
result.note_on_revert: Median length read 16 rounds, outside the 13-15 band named in revert_if, but tower HP is still the untuned placeholder of 16 and pacing is deliberately being tuned last. Not reverted on that basis; the pacing phase inherits it.
